title: T3 Quant Answer-Blind Scorer Result v2
description: Public result structure for 25-item T3 scoring. It records coverage, workflow state and correctness only; it never contains candidate values or expected answers. Cross-field partition rules are enforced by scorer_result_validator.py.

submitted_item_ids.description: All item IDs with an accepted, structurally scorable candidate, regardless of mathematical correctness. Together with missing_item_ids this is a disjoint partition of 1 through 25.

missing_item_ids.description: All item IDs without an accepted, structurally scorable candidate. Together with submitted_item_ids this is a disjoint partition of 1 through 25.

submitted_incorrect_item_ids.description: The mathematically incorrect subset of submitted_item_ids. It is disjoint from the accepted item rows whose correct field is true; those two subsets together equal submitted_item_ids.

submission_state.description: accepted means a structurally scorable candidate was preserved; it does not mean the mathematics is correct. Every other state means no scorable candidate was preserved for this item.

correct.description: Mathematical/date correctness. This may be true only when submission_state is accepted.
